text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One important change is automation, where machines do repetitive tasks that people used to do. This saves time and reduces mistakes. Companies also use productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, to help employees work faster and better. Instead of replacing people completely, AI often works together with humans. This human-AI collaboration means workers can focus on creative and complex tasks while AI handles the routine ones. However, jobs are changing, and employees need new skills to work with these tools. Learning to use AI well will be important for future careers.
